description: Unit tests for authentication hashing utilities, including v1 and v2 hashing, verification, migration, and tenant salt management.

methods.name: getPepper
methods.description: Retrieves the security pepper value used in hashing.

methods.name: hashPasswordV1
methods.description: Creates a legacy v1 password hash using a static secret salt.

methods.name: hashPasswordV2
methods.description: Generates a modern v2 password hash incorporating tenant orgSalt and optional pepper.

methods.name: verifyPassword
methods.description: Verifies a password against a stored hash, considering hashing version and tenant context.

methods.name: ensureTenantOrgSalt
methods.description: Ensures that a tenant document has a valid orgSalt, generating and saving it if missing.

methods.name: hashPassword
methods.description: A wrapper that defaults to v2 hashing, respecting tenant orgSalt and pepper.

methods.name: verifyAndMigrate
methods.description: Verifies a user password, and if using legacy v1, migrates to v2 hash.
